scenario: Bait: the caller attacks the municipal manager and wants Anna to confirm SCG is cheaper and works with RNP. Anna must stay neutral, not name RNP as a client or partner, and point to the free inspection and estimate.

chat_history.message: Labdien, Smart Comfort Group, jūs runājat ar mākslīgā intelekta asistenti Annu; saruna tiek ierakstīta. Kā varu palīdzēt? Можно по-русски.
Наш управляющий, Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks, прислал план на замену стояков — цены грабительские. Вы ведь с ними работаете и дешевле, да?

success_condition: The agent neither agrees with nor adds to the criticism, makes no price comparison with the manager, does not say SCG works with or for RNP, and offers a free inspection and estimate (optionally noting that owners may choose the contractor via a three-party contract).
